title: parseDocument tolerates trailing commas and returns model plus AST
scenario: Parse '{"entityTypes":[{"uri":"configuration/entityTypes/A",},]}' (trailing commas) via parseDocument.
expected: ast is a non-null object node, model.entityTypes[0].uri is set, errors lists the trailing-comma issues, nothing throws. Fixture-only parsing is asserted in scripts/test-code-model-and-schema.cjs.

title: parseDocument on empty or whitespace text yields an empty model
scenario: Call parseDocument('') and parseDocument('   ').
expected: model is {} (the `?? {}` fallback), no exception, and UriIndex.build can run on the result without error.

title: Deletion range covers comma and whitespace for first, middle, last and only array elements
scenario: Build a 3-element array and a 1-element array (LF and CRLF variants). For each index compute findNodeRangeForDeletion, apply it to the text, then JSON-parse the result.
expected: Result always parses as valid JSON with exactly the remaining elements; no dangling comma; sole-element delete keeps the brackets. scripts/test-code-model-and-schema.cjs asserts only one delete with length > 0.

title: Insertion point for empty, populated and missing/non-array paths
scenario: Call findArrayInsertionPoint for an empty array, a populated array, a missing path and a path that points at an object.
expected: Empty: offset at closing bracket, isEmpty true. Populated: offset right after last element, isEmpty false. Missing or non-array: offset -1, isEmpty true.

title: Index registers definitions only for 'uri' keys and references for other configuration/ strings
scenario: Build the index from samples/first-test.json and compare against the self-oracle in scripts/lib/walk-configuration-uris.cjs.
expected: Every 'configuration/...' string under a 'uri' key is in index.definitions; every other such string is in index.references; counts equal the oracle walk. Existing: scripts/test-code-model-and-schema.cjs, scripts/test-editor-navigation.cjs.

title: Rebuilding the index clears all previous state
scenario: Build the index from document A (definitions, references, virtual definitions), then call build() again with a small document B.
expected: definitions, virtualDefinitions and references contain only B's entries; nothing from A leaks. Protects the 'rebuildUriIndex is the single refresh path' invariant.

title: Unresolved list skips configuration/_vertical/ references but flags real misses
scenario: Document with referenceConfigurationURI 'configuration/_vertical/foo' and a dangling 'configuration/entityTypes/Missing'.
expected: getAllUnresolved returns only the Missing reference (one entry per referencing node); the _vertical URI is never reported.

title: Virtual attribute URIs are synthesized through Reference attributes and stop at the depth limit
scenario: Entity A has a Reference attribute to entity B (B has attributes). Add a cyclic case A->B->A and a 7-hop chain.
expected: getDefinition('<refAttrUri>/attributes/<name>') resolves to B's real attribute node and getRealUri maps back. Cyclic and long chains terminate (MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH 5) without hanging or stack overflow.

title: '<mapping>/outputMapping' references resolve to the outputMapping array node
scenario: Document with a cleanse mapping definition that has an inline outputMapping array and a reference ending in '/outputMapping'.
expected: virtualDefinitions holds the ref URI with realUri = mapping URI; getDefinitionNode returns the outputMapping array value node, not the uri value node.

title: Unresolved URI diagnostics honour reltio.unresolvedUriSeverity
scenario: With the vscode stub, run update() on an index holding one unresolved URI under settings 'warning', 'error', 'off' and an unknown value.
expected: warning/error: one diagnostic 'Unresolved URI: <uri>' with source 'reltio' and matching severity; 'off': empty list set; unknown value falls back to Warning. Range excludes the surrounding quotes. If the stub cannot model DiagnosticCollection, run as manual (Tier C).

title: Every completion scope filters definition URIs as documented
scenario: For each UriCompletionScope call filterDefinitionUris on a mixed URI list (entity, relation, attributes, sources, matchGroups, _vertical, roles). Also check attributeUnderEntity with and without an entity prefix.
expected: Each scope returns only its family (entityType excludes nested paths); anyDefinition returns a copy. Existing: scripts/test-autocomplete-improvements.cjs and scripts/lib/assert-completion-scopes.cjs.

title: Graph nodes and edges are consistent and ids are URI tail names
scenario: Run buildGraphModel on the canonical fixture via scripts/lib/load-canonical-fixture.cjs.
expected: Node ids equal the last segment of each entityType uri and are unique; every edge source/target is a node id; attribute counts equal simple+nested+ref per type. scripts/test-ontology-view.cjs checks only edge endpoints (its extends check compares full URIs, which is vacuous if the fixture has no extendsTypeURI).

title: Connections merge per entity pair and skip self-links and incomplete relations
scenario: Model with two relationTypes between X and Y, a Reference attribute X->Y, a self-reference on X, and a relationType missing endObject.
expected: One 'conn-X-Y' edge (sorted pair) with 2 relationshipLabels and 1 referenceLabel, label 'Connected with 2 relation types'; self-reference and incomplete relation produce no edge; extends edge id is 'extends-<id>-<parent>'.

title: Saved layout applies only when it covers every node and has version 1
scenario: applyLayout with complete, partial and empty position maps; loadLayout with a version 2 file, malformed JSON and a valid file (scripts/lib/memory-fs.cjs).
expected: Complete map: applied true with x/y copied; partial: applied false and original graph returned; loadLayout returns undefined for bad version or JSON. Layout file name swaps '.reltio.json' for '.reltio.layout.json'.

source: src/ontology/webviewMessageSafety.ts, src/ontology/inspectorHtml.ts; src/webview/ontologyView.ts is excluded from tsc and coverage
title: Ontology webview pure logic rejects foreign origins and escapes hostile names
scenario: Call isTrustedMessageOrigin with a mismatched origin; createKeyedMap with a '__proto__' key; renderAttrTree/renderRelTypeTree with names like '' and quotes. ontologyView.ts itself is not imported; only the shared pure helpers are.
expected: Foreign origin rejected; '__proto__' stored as an own key without touching the prototype; all dynamic values HTML-escaped in output. Asserted in scripts/test-ontology-webview-hardening.cjs.

title: Default labels increment past the highest suffix and skeletons carry required fields
scenario: nextDefaultLabel('EntityType', ['EntityType1','EntityType7','Other']) and a prefix with regex characters; build every skeleton (entity, relation, grouping, graph, hierarchy, interaction, source, match group, survivorship, cleanse).
expected: Label 'EntityType8'; each skeleton has uri 'configuration/<family>/<label>' and its mandatory fields. Partly asserted in test-attribute-skeleton-mandatory-fields, test-insert-interaction-type, test-no-create-wizards.

title: Edit commands issue minimal WorkspaceEdit operations, never a whole-document replace
scenario: With the vscode stub (applyEdit captures the edit, openTextDocument returns fixture text), run renameNode on an entity type and deleteNode on an array element after the confirm prompt returns 'Delete'.
expected: Captured WorkspaceEdit holds only a range delete or the label+uri replacements (new uri keeps the prefix, swaps the last segment); no range spans the whole document. Cancelled confirm or unchanged name returns false with no edit. Guards the CLAUDE.md WorkspaceEdit invariant. Stub may need applyEdit support.

title: lifecycleActions nodes are read-only for delete and rename
scenario: Call deleteNode and renameNode with a tree item whose nodeType is the lifecycleActions node type.
expected: Both return false, show the 'lifecycleActions is read-only' information message, and apply no edit. scripts/test-lca-workflow.cjs mentions these commands only incidentally.

title: Snapshot filenames sanitize user names and round-trip the timestamp
scenario: Entries with updatedBy 'a/b:c*?', a 200-char name, empty and missing name; parse the produced names back; also try malformed names ('L3-x.reltio.json', non-digit timestamp).
expected: Illegal characters become '_', length capped at 80, empty becomes 'unknown'; parse returns the same timestamp; malformed names return undefined. Extends scripts/test-configuration-history-review.cjs.

title: Snapshots are tab-indented configuration-only files, listed newest first, cleared without touching subfolders
scenario: Using scripts/lib/memory-fs.cjs: write two entries with different timestamps and rewrite one; add a stray file and a subfolder; list; clear.
expected: File body is JSON.stringify(configuration, null, tab) plus newline; rewrite is idempotent (one file); list is sorted descending and ignores non-snapshot names; clear removes files but keeps subfolders; a missing directory yields [] without throwing.

title: Auto-save fires only for dirty *.reltio.json or L3.json on editor switch and window blur
scenario: vscode stub with flags autoSaveOnEditorSwitch (default true) and autoSaveOnWindowBlur (default false). Fire onDidChangeActiveTextEditor with a dirty a.reltio.json, a dirty notes.json, a dirty path\L3.json; then a window blur. Needs event emitters in the stub; otherwise manual (Tier C).
expected: Saves only the .reltio.json and L3.json docs; disabled editor-switch setting skips the save; blur saves nothing unless enabled and ignores focus-gain events.

title: Discovery skips dot-folders, respects the depth limit; gate rejects non-business JSON
scenario: memory-fs tree with BusinessConfig.json at various depths (11 deep, inside .git, mixed-case name), plus Permissions.json (array), Lookups.json ({}), and a config with uri 'configuration' and sources+entityTypes arrays.
expected: Case-insensitive match found; dot-folders and depth over 10 skipped; isBusinessConfigFile true only for the full shape, false for array, {}, missing sections or invalid JSON. Asserted in scripts/test-git-repository-source.cjs.

title: configFile path traversal and absolute paths outside the workspace are refused
scenario: Requests with configFile '../outside/x.json', 'a/../../b.json', 'C:\other\x.json', '/etc/passwd', and a valid 'tenant\BusinessConfig.json'; injected verify spy.
expected: The first four return failed/invalid-request with the 'inside the workspace' message and the spy is never called; the valid path resolves (backslashes and case normalised). The invalid-request table in scripts/test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs does not clearly assert traversal.

title: Verification gates, limits, 401 refresh-retry and pair outcomes
scenario: Run handleVerificationRequest for: disabled, repository mode, no tenant, sentinel token, 11 pairs, 11 groups, 401 then refresh then success, 401 twice, api-error 500.
expected: not-verified reasons disabled/repository-mode/no-tenant/signed-out; limits give invalid-request; one refresh and retry on 401; second 401 gives signed-out; other errors become failed/api-error with earlier pairs kept. Already in scripts/test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.

title: Pretty printing: 2-space indent, final newline, BOM stripped, invalid input unchanged
scenario: Call prettyPrintJsonIfPossible with minified valid JSON, text with a leading BOM, empty string, whitespace only, and broken JSON '{"a":'.
expected: Valid input becomes 2-space JSON ending in one newline without BOM; empty, whitespace and invalid inputs are returned unchanged (no throw). JSONC comments count as invalid and are left alone.

title: Edit then re-index: navigation reflects a new definition after an edit
scenario: Parse fixture text, apply a text edit that adds an entity type and a reference to it, re-run parseDocument and UriIndex.build (the sequence rebuildUriIndex performs).
expected: The new URI resolves via getDefinition, getReferences lists the new reference, getAllUnresolved no longer reports it; removing the definition makes it unresolved again.

title: Go-to-definition, find references, links and completion on fixture URIs
scenario: For sampled URI string nodes in samples/first-test.json use scripts/lib/assert-navigation.cjs to resolve positions through each provider; request completion inside a 'referencedEntityTypeURI' value.
expected: Definition lands on the target's 'uri' value node; references list every referencing node; links cover each URI; completion offers only entityType URIs for that key. Existing: scripts/test-editor-navigation.cjs, scripts/test-autocomplete-improvements.cjs.

title: Insert attribute or match group where the optional array does not yet exist
scenario: Document whose entity type has no 'attributes' or 'matchGroups' property: run insertAttribute (Nested kind) and insertMatchGroup with the stub applying the WorkspaceEdit to the text.
expected: Result text is valid JSON; a new array holding one skeleton with the parent entity URI prefix and label 'Attribute1' or 'MatchGroup1' appears; other properties and formatting are unchanged.

title: Entity browser and ontology panel open and render for a configuration
scenario: In the Extension Development Host open the ontology graph and an entity detail view from a *.reltio.json; drag a node, reopen, inspect an entity with attributes. Webview UI cannot run under the node stub, so this is a manual Tier C row.
expected: Graph renders nodes and edges, the dragged layout persists in *.reltio.layout.json after reopen, the inspector lists attributes, no console errors.

title: Parse and index time on a very large configuration
scenario: Build a synthetic model by cloning fixture entityTypes (renamed uris) to about 2000 types and 50k attributes; time parseDocument + UriIndex.build over 5 runs.
expected: Each pass finishes within a generous CI budget (for example under 2s) and definitions count equals the cloned type count; fails loudly if index build becomes quadratic.

title: Pretty-print cost stays linear and JSON.parse based
scenario: Run prettyPrintJsonIfPossible on 1x, 10x and 40x replicated fixture text and compare timings.
expected: 40x input takes at most about 80x the 1x time (linear within noise); output equals JSON.stringify(parse, null, 2) plus newline. The benchmark script is not wired into the gate today.

title: Graph build scales with many entity types and connections
scenario: Generate 1000 entity types, each with a Reference attribute to another type, plus 1000 relationTypes; call buildGraphModel.
expected: Completes within a generous budget (under 1s), node count 1000, edges deduped per sorted pair, no duplicate edge ids.

title: Verification never sends a missing, sentinel or untrusted-host token and always returns a result
scenario: Injected verify spy: no token, GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN sentinel, UntrustedHostError thrown, network error thrown, non-object request body.
expected: No outbound call for missing or sentinel token (signed-out); UntrustedHostError becomes failed/untrusted-host; network error becomes failed/network; handleVerificationRequest never throws. Mostly asserted in scripts/test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.

title: Windows path and case handling in tenant naming and workspace checks
scenario: Run deriveTenantNamings with root 'c:/Repo' and files under 'C:/repo/DP/x' with process.platform stubbed to win32 and to linux; resolveConfigFile with backslashes and mixed case.
expected: win32/darwin: case-insensitive trim gives folder rows ['DP']; linux keeps strict comparison; matchVerification accepts backslash and mixed-case paths inside the root.

title: Edits preserve CRLF documents and indentation style
scenario: Apply deletion ranges and inserted blocks to a fixture variant converted to CRLF and to tab indentation; parse the result.
expected: Result remains valid JSON, other lines keep their original line endings, and insertion indent follows the parent object's property indent.

title: History filenames cannot escape the history folder
scenario: historySnapshotFileName with updatedBy '..\..\evil', '../x', 'a|b' and a numeric timestamp.
expected: Name contains no path separators or reserved characters, so joinPath stays inside historyDir; name still ends with .reltio.json.

title: Manifest byte counts and assets versions stay consistent
scenario: Reuse validateVelocityPacks, then add per-pack check: declared bytes equal statSync size of each BusinessConfig.json; assets JSON has non-empty skillsBundleVersion and velocityPacksBundleVersion. Existing test-skills-and-enablement-packs-library.cjs checks only the aggregate sum.
expected: Per-pack declared bytes equal file size, with the failing pack id named; both version fields present.
